meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 简化药物发现中的分子数据处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做药物发现或化学信息学，需要处理分子结构数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular data processing in drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery or cheminformatics and need to process molecular structures.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 datamol 库处理化学分子：读取 SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符和指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象、可视化等。所有操作返回 RDKit 分子对象。
howto.when: 当你要求处理化学分子数据（如 SMILES、SDF 文件），或进行药物发现相关分析（如相似性搜索、骨架分析）时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 datamol 读取这个 SDF 文件并计算每个分子的 LogP。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并计算描述符。

say.text: 用 Butina 聚类把这组 SMILES 分子按相似度分组。
say.note: Claude 会进行聚类并输出分组结果。

say.text: 生成这 50 个分子的 ECFP4 指纹并计算两两 Tanimoto 距离。
say.note: Claude 会生成指纹并计算距离矩阵。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the datamol library to process chemical molecules: read SMILES, standardize structures, compute descriptors and fingerprints, cluster, generate 3D conformers, visualize, etc. All operations return RDKit Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process chemical molecular data (e.g., SMILES, SDF files) or perform drug discovery analyses (e.g., similarity search, scaffold analysis).

say_en.text: Read this SDF file with datamol and compute LogP for each molecule.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and compute descriptors.

say_en.text: Cluster these SMILES molecules by similarity using Butina clustering.
say_en.note: Claude will perform clustering and output groups.

say_en.text: Generate ECFP4 fingerprints for these 50 molecules and compute pairwise Tanimoto distances.
say_en.note: Claude will generate fingerprints and compute the distance matrix.
